findings.detail: pipeline feature is defined, but pipeline module is not declared. H owns feature/module declarations; P write scope excludes lib.rs. Consequently P cannot deliver public pipeline::compile within the frozen interface. Add cfg-gated pipeline module export to H and publish revision 2, or explicitly revise ownership and freeze that handoff.

verified_contracts: Machine operations can represent existing unsigned Core S integer backend; arbitrary constants can be synthesized with Li expansion.
Fixed 12-byte branch inverse skip and 8-byte PC-relative jump/call are coherent for 64 MiB text and reserved t6 scratch.
Minimal ELF text plus placeholder R/RW segments and Linux exit adapter scope are internally consistent.
CLI entry validation, atomic output, same-file rejection, determinism and real-source integration criteria are explicit.
limitations: Architecture acceptance only; no encode/image/pipeline implementation is present or approved by this review.
Existing backend still uses textual emission and will be replaced by B; its t6 accesses must respect scratch liveness in implementation.
